rows.speaker: Cotset
rows.en: Young miss, it's the bandit gang! There's quite a lot of them!
rows.display_text:
「Young miss, it's the bandit gang!
There's quite a lot of them!」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: Even better! If we crush every last one, we'll make a profit!
rows.display_text:
「Even better! If we crush every last
one, we'll make a profit!」

rows.speaker: Cotset
rows.en: (This is no good... She's completely blinded by the bounty...)
rows.display_text:
（(This is no good... She's completely
blinded by the bounty...)）

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: Everyone, launch! Don't let a single one of them get away!
rows.display_text:
「Everyone, launch! Don't let a single one
of them get away!」

rows.speaker: Rag
rows.en: Ha! This'll get my blood pumping!
rows.display_text: 「Ha! This'll get my blood pumping!」

rows.speaker: Maria
rows.en: B-but... to think even Chill and I would end up launching too...
rows.display_text:
「B-but... to think even Chill and I would
end up launching too...」

rows.speaker: Chill
rows.en: I'm a member of the Sand Rats too, y'know! I'll do it, dang it!
rows.display_text:
「I'm a member of the Sand Rats too,
y'know! I'll do it, dang it!」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: That's the spirit, Chill! Everyone, get fired up and go!
rows.display_text:
「That's the spirit, Chill! Everyone, get
fired up and go!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: I know! Let's go, everyone! Time to take out these bandits!
rows.display_text:
「I know! Let's go, everyone! Time to
take out these bandits!」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: Target: 350,000 in earnings! All Walker Machines, charge!!
rows.display_text:
「Target: 350,000 in earnings! All Walker
Machines, charge!!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: All right! We took down the bandit gang!
rows.display_text:
「All right! We took down the bandit
gang!」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: Cotset! What's our take!?
rows.display_text: 「Cotset! What's our take!?」

rows.speaker: Cotset
rows.en: Earnings: {tm}! Target cleared!
rows.display_text: 「Earnings: {tm}! Target cleared!」

rows.speaker: Rag
rows.en: Hahaha! A total win! This means we're done with the poor life!
rows.display_text:
「Hahaha! A total win! This means we're
done with the poor life!」

rows.speaker: Chill
rows.en: Yay! Now we won't have to worry about food anymore!
rows.display_text:
「Yay! Now we won't have to worry about
food anymore!」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: By my calculations, if we'd really pushed it, we could've earned 500,000, but well, I suppose this'll do.
rows.display_text:
「By my calculations, if we'd really
pushed it, we could've earned 500,000, but
well, I suppose this'll do.」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: Great work, everyone! Tonight, it's a big victory party!
rows.display_text:
「Great work, everyone! Tonight, it's a
big victory party!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Tonight, I'm eating till I'm stuffed!!
rows.display_text: 「Tonight, I'm eating till I'm stuffed!!」

rows.speaker: Cotset
rows.en: This is exactly why we never manage to save any money!
rows.display_text:
「This is exactly why we never manage to
save any money!」

rows.speaker: Cotset
rows.en: Earnings: {tm}! We haven't reached the target!
rows.display_text:
「Earnings: {tm}! We haven't reached
the target!」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: Ehh!? That means we're in the red!!
rows.display_text: 「Ehh!? That means we're in the red!!」

rows.speaker: Rag
rows.en: Tch...! All that effort for nothing, huh!
rows.display_text: 「Tch...! All that effort for nothing, huh!」

rows.speaker: Chill
rows.en: Aah... back to the poor life again...
rows.display_text: 「Aah... back to the poor life again...」

rows.speaker: Dike
rows.en: The bandit gang, they're making a run for it!
rows.display_text:
「The bandit gang, they're making a run
for it!」

rows.speaker: Blume
rows.en: We roughed them up that badly. They'll probably stay quiet for a while.
rows.display_text:
「We roughed them up that badly. They'll
probably stay quiet for a while.」

rows.speaker: Blume
rows.en: Tch! We can't catch up from here!
rows.display_text: 「Tch! We can't catch up from here!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Chasing down wanted criminals, huh?
rows.display_text: 「Chasing down wanted criminals, huh?」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: That's right. A bounty's finally been put on that bandit gang that's been raiding the bazaars.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. A bounty's finally been
put on that bandit gang that's been
raiding the bazaars.」

rows.speaker: Dike
rows.en: So, we're the ones taking these guys down, huh.
rows.display_text:
「So, we're the ones taking these guys
down, huh.」

rows.speaker: Rag
rows.en: Heh... don't make me laugh. So an honest hauler can't turn a profit, and now we're bounty hunters?
rows.display_text:
「Heh... don't make me laugh. So an
honest hauler can't turn a profit, and
now we're bounty hunters?」

rows.speaker: Blume
rows.en: Can't be helped, can it. Under Elchi's command, our main business has been in the red nonstop anyway.
rows.display_text:
「Can't be helped, can it. Under Elchi's
command, our main business has been in
the red nonstop anyway.」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: Don't say things that make me sound bad! Clearing out bandits is basically a hauler's duty.
rows.display_text:
「Don't say things that make me sound
bad! Clearing out bandits is basically a
hauler's duty.」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: With dangerous types like that around, we can't even do business ourselves.
rows.display_text:
「With dangerous types like that around,
we can't even do business ourselves.」

rows.speaker: Birin
rows.en: What she's saying isn't wrong, at least.
rows.display_text: 「What she's saying isn't wrong, at least.」

rows.speaker: Maria
rows.en: That's true. There really are people in trouble, and we can't just leave them be.
rows.display_text:
「That's true. There really are people in
trouble, and we can't just leave them be.」

rows.speaker: Chill
rows.en: We're the ones in trouble too, y'know! At this rate, we'll be worrying about tomorrow's food!
rows.display_text:
「We're the ones in trouble too, y'know!
At this rate, we'll be worrying about
tomorrow's food!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Then it's settled. Helping people, keeping business safe, and the bounty -- three birds with one stone.
rows.display_text:
「Then it's settled. Helping people,
keeping business safe, and the bounty --
three birds with one stone.」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: If we're doing this, let's go all out!
rows.display_text: 「If we're doing this, let's go all out!」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: Captain's orders! While we're taking down the bandit gang, we're earning as much money as we possibly can!
rows.display_text:
「Captain's orders! While we're taking
down the bandit gang, we're earning as
much money as we possibly can!」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: Target funds... 350,000!
rows.display_text: 「Target funds... 350,000!」
